---
title: "SRA TRUST4 — CDR3 & Assembly Length Distributions"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
source(here::here("R", "exclusions.R"))
source(here::here("R", "trust4_files.R"))
source(here::here("R", "metadata.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(vroom)
library(ggrepel)

TRUST4_DIR  <- data_path("trust4/TRUST4results")
METADATA_XL <- data_path("metadata/2024-SRARunTable-MetadataCleaning.xlsx")
FIGURES_DIR <- out_path("figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## 1. Load Metadata

```{r load-metadata}
metadata <- read_metadata(METADATA_XL) %>%
  select(Run, BioProject, create_date, Tissue, `Cell Type`, Age, Sex,
         Disease, `Disease Class`, DonorID, Treatment, `Patient State`,
         EDSS, `Years disease`)
```

## 2. CDR3 (Junction) Length

```{r junction-length-data}
# One AIRR file per SRA run (R/trust4_files.R); SRA runs only (in-house files carry no accession)
all_files  <- list.files(TRUST4_DIR, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "airr\\.tsv$")
kept_files <- keep_one_file_per_run(all_files)
cat(sprintf("%d extra files left out: %s\n", length(all_files) - length(kept_files),
            paste(basename(setdiff(all_files, kept_files)), collapse = ", ")))
airr_files <- tibble(path = kept_files) %>%
  mutate(SRA = str_extract(basename(path), "(SRR|ERR)[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SRA))

junction_raw <- map2(airr_files$path, airr_files$SRA,
                     ~ vroom(.x, col_select = c("junction_aa", "v_call"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
                         mutate(SRA = .y))

filtering <- junction_raw %>%
  map(filter, str_starts(v_call, "IGH")) %>%
  map(left_join, metadata, by = c("SRA" = "Run")) %>%
  data.table::rbindlist() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(BioProject, Disease, `Disease Class`, Age, Sex, DonorID,
         Tissue, `Cell Type`, v_call, junction_aa) %>%
  drop_duplicate_repertoires("BioProject", "DonorID")   # duplicated repertoires (R/exclusions.R)

rm(junction_raw)
gc()

head(filtering)
```

## 3. CDR3 Length — Distribution Plot

```{r junction-length-plot}
plot_data <- filtering %>%
  filter(!is.na(Disease), Tissue %in% c("Blood", "CSF")) %>%
  mutate(
    Disease        = fct_lump(Disease, n = 1, other_level = "Controls"),
    junction_length = str_length(junction_aa)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(junction_length), between(junction_length, 10, 30))

p_cdr3_density <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = junction_length, fill = Disease)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.8, adjust = 5) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Tissue)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "inferno") +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 2, panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "CDR3 Length (aa)", y = "Normalized Density",
       title = "IGH CDR3 length distribution: MS vs Controls")

p_cdr3_density
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig1I_cdr3_length_density.svg"),
       p_cdr3_density, width = 4, height = 6)
```

## 4. Significance Test — CDR3 Length

```{r}

plot_data %>%
  group_by(Tissue) %>%
  group_map(function(df, key) {
    ms  <- df %>% filter(Disease == levels(df$Disease)[1]) %>% pull(junction_length)
    ctl <- df %>% filter(Disease == "Controls") %>% pull(junction_length)
    wt  <- t.test(ms, ctl)
    tibble(
      Tissue       = key$Tissue,
      n_MS         = length(ms),
      n_Controls   = length(ctl),
      mean_MS    = mean(ms),
      mean_Ctrl  = mean(ctl),
      t            = wt$statistic,
      p_value      = wt$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
         sig   = case_when(
           p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
           p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
           p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
           TRUE          ~ "ns"
         )) -> cdr3_tests
cdr3_tests
write_csv(cdr3_tests, file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig1I_cdr3_length_tests.csv"))
```
